'''Ivan''' (Japanese: '''ショウタ''' ''Shōta'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG039|A Poké-BLOCK Party!]]''.

Ivan won the [[Trick House]] challenge in his [[hometown]], [[Mauville City]], and was rewarded for this by the [[Trick Master]]. He struggled to hold up the year supply of [[Pokéblock]] and toppled over because of the weight, as {{an|May}} and [[Alanna]] watched and giggled. Later, {{an|Jigglypuff}} took to the stage and {{m|Sing|sung}} to the audience, making everyone fall {{status|asleep}} including Ivan.

==Pokémon competitions==
Ivan has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}:
* [[Trick House#In animation|Trick House Contest]] - Winner (''[[AG039|A Poké-BLOCK Party!]]'')
